analysis: Targeted reflection rebuilds targets with original user preselected, while the no-target reflection branch directly checks failure and processes an empty list using reflector as actual user. WP47-A171 reads broadly. For default Spikes/ToxicSpikes/StealthRock/StickyWeb FoeSide data, an optional reconstruction still returns empty because the inherited additional-target callback does nothing, and the actual general effect uses reflector opposing side. A mere extra read/query sequence is not yet a minimal observable mismatch with a default consumer. Separate the branches for precision if root judges warranted, but do not promote this as behavioral defect solely from structural call difference. Valid extensions or differing callbacks need concrete assumptions/receiver evidence, not invented caller capability.
